capabilities: create a link whose display text is added as an alias to the target note's frontmatter
create plain links via the standard Obsidian autocompletion popup
toggle the display text of an existing link on or off
keep selected text as link target so autocompletion offers matching terms
create the target note automatically when it does not exist
extras: The README notes aliases are sorted longest to shortest so Obsidian backlinks detect correctly, and that the author solicits donations for their knowledge-base project.
problem: Obsidian's link autocompletion replaces link display text and offers no way to write the display text into the target note's aliases property.
summary: Link-creation plugin that stores a link's display text as an alias in the target note's frontmatter and keeps display text intact during autocompletion.
